card.name: Separators inside web page titles
card.fires_on: Separator or joining marks and short words inside website titles and citation entries, such as ~, -, &, or a comma between title parts. Also partway through URL paths like FrontPage or /en.

modes.label: Title separators
modes.description: Dash, tilde, ampersand or comma between parts of a web page or site title in a reference list.
modes.example: Texas Escapes<< ->> Blueprints For Travel, LLC. Retrieved

modes.label: URL path pieces
modes.description: Pieces inside web addresses, such as page names or language folders.

card.plain: It fires on the dashes, tildes and similar marks that split up web page titles in source lists and links.
